extraction.description: A UiPath Agents evaluation import dialog is open titled “Import evaluation set.” The modal contains a large JSON text editor populated with an evaluation set definition, including fileName, id, name, batchSize, evaluatorRefs, and evaluations. The Import button in the bottom-right is visually emphasized, with Cancel next to it and a close icon in the top-right.
extraction.step_instructions: Click on the Import button to import the pasted evaluation set JSON. If you need to abandon the import, click Cancel or the × close icon.
